name: Question 2
problem: Find all of the subsets of $A={-1,1}.$
worked_solution:
To find every subset of $A,$ we list out every combination of elements within $A.$ 

We can use the following diagram to visualize the process:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14070456/assets/6c08214e0ec5c2700561f9162c263c9677c621ff240823c261ce446dde38486a.png)

Note that we must include the empty set, since it is a subset of every set.

By doing this, we get

$$
∅,{-1},{1},{-1,1}.
$$
